name: OpenStock
description: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
one_liner: A free, open-source stock-market app — live prices, alerts, company research — that anyone can run themselves instead of paying for a commercial trading platform.
buyer: An independent financial newsletter writer or small advisory who wants to launch a branded stock-alerts app for a specific niche (e.g. dividend stocks, a single country's market) without building a market-data platform from scratch.
business_use_cases: A finance newsletter operator self-hosts a branded fork to give paying subscribers a live watchlist and alert tool as a value-add.
A small RIA (registered investment advisor) deploys it internally as a free client-facing portfolio dashboard instead of paying for an expensive vendor platform.
A fintech hobbyist forks it to build a niche screener for one market (e.g. emerging-market small caps) that big platforms ignore.

money_ideas.idea: Host a managed, branded version for niche newsletter operators and charge per-seat.
Offer paid setup/hosting for advisors who want it running but don't want to manage Docker and MongoDB themselves.

steal_this: Fork it, restrict it to one under-served market or stock niche, and launch it as a paid-alerts Telegram bot by Monday — the market-data and alert plumbing is already built.
